ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Strengthen gluconeogenesis (PEP supply) in the formatotrophic strain

generalizable_rule.rule_text: For E. coli FC8 growing solely on CO2 and formic acid in M9 minimal medium, lowering the cultivation temperature from 37 C to 32 C increased cyoAB relative to cydAB expression, suppressed filamentation, and improved biomass yield on formate (0.0552 vs 0.0365 g DCW/g FA).
generalizable_rule.scope: Formatotrophic E. coli FC8 cultivated on CO2+FA in M9 minimal medium in shake flasks/bioreactor
generalizable_rule.evidence_basis: mechanistic_inference supported by measured mRNA ratios (Extended Data Fig. 7d), biomass yields (Fig. 2e) and growth profiles (Fig. 2d)
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli FC8; M9 + sodium formate; 10% CO2/18% O2/72% N2 gas; 30-37 C range; flask and 1.3-l bioreactor
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: Other hosts, other strains, other carbon/energy sources, rich media, temperatures outside 28-37 C, and any causal claim that temperature-mediated Cyo/Cyd changes generally suppress filamentation - not tested in this paper

alternatives_considered: 30 C and 33 C (monitored; 32 C gave the highest growth)

source_locations.quote: We engineered Escherichia coli to grow on CO2 and formic acid alone by introducing the synthetic CO2 and formic acid assimilation pathway...
Development of an E. coli strain that can efficiently grow to a higher cell density on CO2 and FA alone is needed for industrial biotechnology applications.

We hypothesized that insufficient gluconeogenesis, simultaneous expression of the purT and ftl genes, and inefficient NADPH supply might be the reasons for the inability of the FC1 strain to grow solely on CO and FA.
We hypothesized that cell filamentation might be due to energy deficiency in the cells when growing on CO and FA alone.

paper_target_strains.role: engineered strain (first to grow on CO2+FA alone)

sequence: EXP1 stepwise strain construction FC1->FC2->FC3->FC5 with growth tests
EXP2 13C isotope confirmation of CO2/FA assimilation
EXP5 FC8 high-inoculum flask test (filamentation observed)
experiment_workflow.design_build_test_learn_note: The narrative follows iterative design cycles: each strain generation addressed a stated hypothesis from the previous generation's phenotype.

design_logic.overall_strategy: Introduce a synthetic CO2/formate assimilation pathway into E. coli, then iteratively remove bottlenecks (gluconeogenesis, competing purT route, NADPH supply, expression burden, energy efficiency) and optimize process conditions to maximize cell density on CO2 and FA alone.
